subject: general
question: The induced current is highest when the direction of motion of the coil is at ________ with respect to the magnetic field.
solution:
__
 
• The induced current is highest when the direction of motion of the coil is at **90°__** or perpendicular with respect to the magnetic field, as the flux cutting is maximum in this case.
 
• While it is minimum when the direction of motion of the coil is at 180° or parallel with respect to the magnetic field, as here the flux cutting by the coil will be minimum.
